blocks.text: Is kingdom mein plants (poday) aate hain: eukaryotic, multicellular jandar jin ki cell walls cellulose ki hoti hain. Yeh autotrophic hain aur photosynthesis se apni ghiza banate hain. Tamam poday embryo se develop hote hain. Misaalein: mosses (kaai), ferns, conifers aur flowering plants (phool wale poday).
Podon ke do bare groups hain:

items: Nonvascular plants ya bryophytes mein conducting tissues (xylem aur phloem, yani paani aur ghiza le jaane wale tissues) nahi hote. Misaalein: liverworts, hornworts aur mosses.
Vascular plants mein conducting tissues hote hain. Yeh do qisam ke hain: seedless plants (beej ke baghair, jaise ferns) aur seed plants (beej wale, jaise conifers aur flowering plants).

blocks.alt: Nau podon ke khaake teen qataaron mein. Nonvascular plants: moss (gaddi jaisa hara guchha, dandiyon par capsules), liverwort (chapta, do-shaakha thallus jis par gemma cups hain) aur hornwort (chapta thallus jis se seeng jaise sporophytes nikalte hain). Seed plants, gymnosperms: sago palm, pine, Cedrus aur Ginkgo biloba. Seed plants, phool wale podey: Capsicum (laal mirch) aur mustard (sarson, peele phool).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.8: Kingdom Plantae ke bare groups (kitab ki Figure 1.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; gymnosperms wali qataar ka sahih unwan).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar wali qataar ke podon (moss, liverwort, hornwort) mein xylem aur phloem nahi hote. Beech wali qataar ke poday (sago palm, pine, Cedrus, Ginkgo biloba) gymnosperms hain: in ke beej hote hain lekin phal ke andar nahi. Neeche wali qataar (capsicum yani shimla mirch, mustard yani sarson) flowering plants hain, jin ke beej phal ke andar hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein beech wali qataar (sago palm, pine, Cedrus, Ginkgo biloba) ke neeche 'Seedless vascular plants' likha hai. Yeh ghalat hai: yeh sab beej (seed) wale podey hain, jinhein gymnosperms kehte hain; in ke beej phal ke andar nahi hote. Seedless vascular plants ki misaal ferns hain, jo is tasveer mein nahi hain. Is liye hamare khaake mein beech wali qataar 'Seed plants: gymnosperms' aur neeche wali (capsicum, mustard) 'Seed plants: flowering plants' hai.

blocks.caption: Teen domains ke kingdoms ki pehchaan wali khasoosiyat

blocks.text: Table ke har column ko ek kingdom ka khaka samajh kar parhein. Kitab Bacteria aur Archaea dono ko purane kingdom Monera ke neeche dikhati hai, kyunke five-kingdom system mein tamam prokaryotes Monera mein thay.
